verdict.rationale: Stable's own docs state that the API "currently" covers only searching and retrieving MailItems, creating and onboarding Locations (including USPS 1583, signature packets and sessions), and some Company and Check objects. Many UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent: scanning, forwarding, check deposit, shredding, tagging, auto-routing, and team or role assignment. Webhooks and API keys are configured only through the dashboard. missing for 10: API coverage of mail actions (scan/ship/deposit/shred), tags and routing rules, team/user/role management, webhook and API-key management via API, and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
